LynCo-Patch: F20
Source: 795f80012036d4ed53533cf2378d2c20195a2b8f

Share core's existing authored-verdict identity at direct, graph-retry and offline recovery boundaries. Provider/protocol failures retain their failed gate without inventing code changes or consuming a revision attempt. Deterministic script remediation is preserved.

Adapt donor tests to upstream's named atomic remediation producer: the recovery sweep no longer owns aggregate counters. Positive tests assert the named publisher receives findings and the keyed claim, rather than demanding obsolete send-back behavior.

Validation: adapted 17-case regression on upstream fails 14 negative cases and passes its 3 positive controls. Patched regression plus neighboring optional-step recovery suite passes 208 tests on Linux/Node 22.16.0. Actual database publication remains upstream's existing transaction; these focused tests use seams, not a live PG instance.

Delete-when: upstream distinguishes unavailable/malformed/non-revision review from authored REVISE across all recovery entrypoints and preserves script remediation without duplicate budget ownership.
